label: star

files.burxt.package:
name        comet-showcase
version     0.1.0

dependency  star  https://github.com/andrecorugda/star-burxt  v0.2.0
dependency  bmx   https://github.com/andrecorugda/bmx         burxt-0.12.1

install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates gcc libc6-dev git && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

mkdir -p /tmp/b /usr/local/lib/burxt && tar xzf /tmp/b.tgz -C /tmp/b --strip-components=1 && install -m 755 /tmp/b/burxt /usr/local/bin/burxt && install -m 644 /tmp/b/lib/*.bx /usr/local/lib/burxt/ && rm -rf /tmp/b /tmp/b.tgz
sample:
:props: amount: Int, tone: String
:!props:

:span: class=badge
{{ tone }}: {{ to_string(amount) }}
:!span:
